driver:
program probe
use problem_in_mod, only: interactive_read
use data_in_struct_mod, only: seen_in,size_in,n_well_in
use structures_mod
implicit none
integer :: i,tail
read(*,*) tail
seen_in=0
size_in=0
n_well_in=0
seen_in(50,3)=tail
call interactive_read
write(*,'(A,2I8)') 'dimensions ',n_dna,n_allele
write(*,'(A,100ES25.16E3)') 'dna ',dna
write(*,'(A,100ES25.16E3)') 'wells ',n_well
write(*,'(A,100I8)') 'sizes ',allele_size
write(*,'(A,2I8)') 'parents ',progenitor
do i=1,n_dna
write(*,'(A,100ES25.16E3)') 'seen ',seen(i,:,data)
end do
end program
scope: Original interactive reader and conversion, with unused input arrays zeroed
